_comment: Random affix pool for Omega Realm items. Holds the rollable affixes (prefixes/suffixes) that can be attached to weapons/armor, each with the stat it modifies, value range, and tier/rarity gating. The Rust omega-server is the numeric authority: affixes are rolled and applied server-side when items generate and their stat effects are enforced in the sim ('the client requests, the server decides'); this file mirrors definitions for client display/tooling and the server wins on disagreement. Governing GDD doc: docs/gdd/loot.md (affix system is an explicit open question; STATUS: TBD/UNBUILT — no affix system in code today), data/schemas/item_schema.json, data/loot/rarity_weights.json (affix count per rarity). TODO: the whole affix list and all ranges are unfilled pending design; the single example below is schema-shape only.

affixes._comment: Keyed by stable affix id. One schema-shaped example entry. 'kind' = prefix|suffix; value_range is rolled at item-generation time; tier/rarity fields gate where the affix can appear.
